2: For the music director, according to Muth-labben. A psalm of David. I will thank Yahweh with all my heart. I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
3: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing the praise of your name, O Most High.
4: When my enemies turn back, they will stumble and perish because of your presence.
5: For you have maintained my just cause; you have sat on the throne judging correctly.
6: You have rebuked the nations; you have destroyed the wicked. Their name you have blotted out forever and ever.
7: The enemies are destroyed in ruins forever, and you have uprooted their cities; their very memory has perished.
8: But Yahweh sits enthroned forever. He has established his throne for judgment.
9: And he will judge the world with righteousness. He will judge the peoples with equity.
10: And Yahweh will be a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of distress.
11: And those who know your name will trust in you, for you do not forsake those who seek you, O Yahweh.
12: Sing praises to Yahweh who sits enthroned in Zion. Tell his deeds among the peoples,
13: for he who ⌞avenges bloodshed⌟ remembers them. He does not forget the distressed cry of the afflicted.
14: Be gracious to me, O Yahweh. See my suffering from those who hate me, you who lift me up from the gates of death,
15: so that I may tell of all your praises. In the gates of the daughter of Zion let me rejoice in your salvation.
16: The nations have fallen in the pit that they made; their foot is caught in the net that they hid.
17: Yahweh has made himself known; he has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his hands. Higgaion Selah
18: The wicked shall turn back to Sheol, all the nations forgetting God,
19: for the needy shall not always be forgotten; the hope of the poor shall never perish.
20: Rise up, O Yahweh, let not humans prevail; let the nations be judged before you.
21: O Yahweh, put them in fear. Let the nations know they are merely human. Selah
